section_or_rule_title: Payment of minimum rates of wages
exact_text: (1) Where in respect of any scheduled employment a notification under section 5 is in force, the employer shall pay to every employee engaged in a scheduled employment under him wages at a rate not less than the minimum rate of wages fixed by such notification for that class of employees in that employment without any deductions except as may be authorised.
legal_status_notes: Repealed on 21 November 2025 by Code on Wages 2019.

exact_text: (1) Where an employee, whose minimum rate of wages is fixed under this Act by the hour, by the day or by such a longer wage-period as may be prescribed, works on any day in excess of the number of hours constituting a normal working day, the employer shall pay him for every hour or for part of an hour so worked in excess at the overtime rate fixed under this Act or under any law of the appropriate Government for the time being in force, whichever is higher.
legal_status_notes: Repealed on 21 November 2025 by Code on Wages 2019.
key_topics: work in excess of normal working day

exact_text:
(1) The appropriate Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint an Authority to hear and decide for any specified area all claims arising out of payment of less than the minimum rates of wages or in respect of the payment of remuneration for days of rest or for work done on such days under clause (b) or clause (c) of sub-section (1) of section 13 or of wages at the overtime rate under section 14...
(2) Where an employee has any claim of the nature referred to in sub-section (1), the employee himself, or any legal practitioner or any official of a registered trade union... may apply to such Authority for a direction under sub-section (3):
Provided that every such application shall be presented within six months from the date on which the minimum wages or other amount became payable.
legal_status_notes: Repealed on 21 November 2025 by Code on Wages 2019. Prescribed 6-month window for minimum wage claims.
